info.name: pdf-server
info.description:
Standalone Rust/Axum service that renders PDFs from Typst templates. **No authentication** — every route here is open, so there is no Bearer/API-key setup needed.

Base URL (and a sample `templateKey`) are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment (Development/Production) to point requests at the right instance.

**Phase 1 status**: only `Render`'s `POST /{templateKey}` does real work beyond a status stub — `Templates` and `Documents` currently each expose only a `GET /` module-status stub (their real read routes are Phase 2/3 work), so this collection reflects exactly what's implemented today.

**Getting a real `{{templateKey}}`**: the seed `invoice` template is created automatically the first time the server starts (see `templates/invoice.typ`). Since `GET /api/templates`'s real listing endpoint isn't built yet, read it directly from the SQLite database — `sqlite3 pdf_server.db "SELECT key, name FROM templates;"` (path per that instance's `DATABASE_URL`) — then set the environment's `templateKey` variable to that value.

request.description: Liveness check — always returns 200 if the process is up and able to handle a request at all. Doesn't touch SQLite or the render engine, so it can't distinguish "server up, database down".
Trivial "is this module wired up" check — not a health/readiness probe.

Compiles the `invoice` template (see `templates/invoice.typ`'s header comment for its full JSON contract) against this request body and returns the rendered PDF as raw bytes — `Content-Type: application/pdf`, **not** the usual `{success, data, message}` envelope every other endpoint in this collection uses. Postman will offer to preview or save the response as a PDF.

Errors still go through the standard envelope: 404 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown/inactive `{{templateKey}}`, 422 `RENDER_VALIDATION_FAILED` if the body doesn't satisfy the template's data contract, 500 `PDF_EXPORT_FAILED` on export failure.
Phase 1 status stub only — the real `GET /` (list templates) and `GET /{key}` (get one template's metadata/data-contract) read routes are Phase 2 work, not built yet.

Phase 1 status stub only — the real `GET /` (list rendered documents), `GET /{key}` (get one record), and `GET /{key}/pdf` (reprint) read routes are Phase 3 work, not built yet. Every successful `Render Invoice` call already writes a row here — see the `documents` table in SQLite.
